summary.text: Chris Kassin is a Republican state representative who has represented South Dakota House District 17 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A higher-education development and athletics administrator, he faces Republican Troy Redler and Democrats Austin Brunick and Leslie Gerrish for the district's two seats, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Chris Kassin graduated from Huron High School and earned a B.S. in criminal justice and corrections in 2002 and an M.P.A. in 2005, both from the University of South Dakota, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists his career experience as vice president of external relations of the University of South Dakota Foundation, vice president for strategy and athletic director of Mount Marty University, and assistant athletic director at the University of South Dakota.
Kassin took office on January 10, 2023, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists his committee assignment as House Appropriations.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he had lived in Vermillion for more than 20 years, supports low taxes and regulation and a pro-business climate, and named a strong economy, great schools and quality health care as policy priorities.
